Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.16543866666666668, 0.22419999999999998, 0.1706666666666667, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "DELETION RECORDED", "label_box": [ 0.09640000000000001, 0.4862, 0.308744, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "box", "box": [ 0.5, 0.2242, 0.292744, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "NO REVISION HELD", "label_box": [ 0.492, 0.4862, 0.308744, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.17, 0.08, 0.64, 0.07 ], "color": "steel", "label": "EXPORT: 4 JUNE–14 JULY", "label_box": [ 0.17, 0.155, 0.64, 0.06 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** A retrospective evidence card, dated `EXPORT WINDOW — 4 JUNE–14 JULY 2026`, separates deletion records from surviving contents. Show 1,246 page outlines labelled `DELETION RECORDED · NO REVISION HELD`, with empty interiors. No arrival-rate comparison.

**Caption:**
> 1,246 DELETED PAGES HAVE NO REVISION IN THIS EXPORT. A DELETION COUNT CANNOT TELL US WHAT THOSE PAGES SAID.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — the corpus records 1,246 deletion-only pages with no stored revision alongside the stored ones (`dse_admin_deleted_pages_without_held_page`); this is an archive-coverage limit, not a measured deletion or arrival rate.

", "title": "Deletion records survive without the deleted pages’ contents" } }
